activity_summary: You kept one picture: a hot lane, and two men with bucklers. You did not give them words. Brooke stays up. The king stays with Garnish. The letter is still unsent, and it still names no day.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the picture, and did not write it out.
